reference_input.description: Path to a reference input (JSON, fasta, excel, or Genbank files). NOTE: a single fasta, excel, JSON is required. For Genbank files, multiple can be specified, but the command needs ' ' to prevent shell script issues.

technology.description: Technology to guide workflow. Guides QC and alignment.

skip_fastqc.description: Skip FastQC (both the initial and post-trim runs). Enabled (skipped) by default; set false to run FastQC.

skip_multiqc.description: Skip the MultiQC aggregate report. Enabled (skipped) by default; set false to run MultiQC.

adapter_fasta.description: FASTA file containing adapter sequences for trimming. If unset, defaults to the bundled Illumina adapter file at `../asap/illumina_adapters_all.fasta`.

fastp_extra_args.description: Extra args for fastp or fastplong.

filter_secondary_alignments.description: Drop secondary/supplementary alignment records (samtools view -F 0x900) immediately after alignment, so downstream read counts (mapped_reads, amplicon_reads, aligned_reads, depth/breadth) stay consistent. Disable to retain all alignment records emitted by the aligner.

primer_file.description: Path to a primer file for primer removal via either primer masking or iVar trimming. Accepts EITHER a ready-made BED or a primer CSV. BED: no headers, 6 columns: reference, start, end, name, integer, strand (+/-) (SEE: https://andersen-lab.github.io/ivar/html/manualpage.html). NOTE1: The +/- strand direction is critical and based on the reference (i.e.m + notations must be on left, - must be on the right). NOTE2: PRIMER MASKING will mask Forward and Reverse primers if they are within the wiggle and on appropriate side of the amplicon. CSV: a file ending in `.csv` with 3 columns (primer_name, direction, sequence) is auto-detected and converted to a BED by searching the pipeline reference for each primer (see --primer_max_mismatch); the generated BED and the full search results are published to `<outdir>/primer_bed/`.

primer_max_mismatch.description: FOR PRIMER CSV -> BED CONVERSION ONLY: Max mismatches allowed when locating each primer in the reference. Ambiguity codes (e.g. Y, S) count as mismatches, so set this above the number of ambiguous bases in your primers.

mask_primers.description: Enable primer masking. Auto-enabled when `--primer_file` is provided (unless explicitly set to `false`).

wiggle.description: FOR PRIMER MASKING ONLY: Wiggle distance for primer masking.

mask_bam.description: FOR PRIMER MASKING ONLY: Whether to mask primers in the BAM file.

primer_only.description: FOR PRIMER MASKING ONLY: Only perform primer masking.

ref_names.description: Name(s) of the reference contig(s) for which identity is calculated; if omitted, apply to all contigs.

filter_pairs.description: If either mate of a read pair fails the identity check on a checked reference, mark both mates as unaligned/discarded. Set to false to filter each mate independently.

smor_correction_qual_diff_threshold.description: Phred quality score difference required between paired-read bases at a mismatch position for the higher-quality base to be selected during SMOR consensus correction (generateSMORbam_correction.py -q argument). If below this threshold, the position is masked with fill_character.

smor_correction_agreement_method.description: How SMOR consensus correction combines the two base qualities when both reads of a pair agree at a position (generateSMORbam_correction.py -a argument): 'sum' = min(q1+q2, 60) (default), 'max' = max(q1, q2).

variant_calling_options.title: Shared Variant Calling and Consensus Options

proportion.description: Minimum proportion required to call a variant/iSNV at a given locus (iVar variant -t argument).

consensus_proportion.description: Minimum proportion required to call a base at that position, else 'N' (iVar consensus -c argument).

depth.description: Minimum read depth (>=) required to consider a position covered. Applied by bam_processor for SNP calling and by all R reporting scripts (coverage table, SNP table, plots) for filtering and breadth calculations. (iVar consensus -m argument).

min_base_qual.description: Minimum base quality score to use a position for variant/iSNV or consensus calling (phred scale, i.e. 10=90, 20=99, 30=99.9 accuracy) (iVar variant and consensus -q argument).

bam_processor_options.title: bam_processor Specific Options and JSON generation

asap_snps.description: Enable ASAP BAM processing (newBamProcessor.py). Set to `false` to skip SNP/consensus profiling.

breadth.description: Minimum breadth of coverage required to consider an amplicon as present

mutation_depth.description: Minimum number of reads required to call a mutation at a given locus.

fill_character.description: Character to use for filling gaps.

fill_gaps.description: Character written at zero-coverage positions in the consensus sequence (passed to `--fill-gaps`).

mark_deletions.description: Character written at deletion positions in the consensus sequence (passed to `--mark-deletions`).

suppress_per_base.description: Suppress the per-position output arrays (consensus, gapfilled_consensus, depths, proportions, n_reads, ref_positions) in each sample's XML. Set true for large/whole-genome references to keep XML sizes manageable.

prune_per_base.description: Prune the per-position numeric arrays (depths, proportions, n_reads, quality_discards) to only positions with depth >= depth, emitting a matching sparse ref_positions; the consensus sequence is kept full-length. Shrinks output for large/whole-genome references while retaining per-base data at covered positions. Ignored when suppress_per_base is true.

codon_correction.description: Annotate pairs of SNPs that fall in the same codon (per GenBank CDS annotations) with read-level allele-linkage information (<codon_merge>/<combo> XML elements). Requires --reference_input to resolve to GenBank file(s) (.gb/.gbk/.genbank), or --asaptools_genbank_location to be set.

codon_correction_error.description: Frequency tolerance (0–1) between two same-codon SNPs' variant frequencies for their <codon_merge> linkage to be classified as 'complete' (both SNPs change together) vs. 'partial'.

codon_correction_min_reads.description: Minimum spanning reads required to confirm codon-level SNP linkage.

discover_roi.description: Annotate each SNP with co-occurring variants detected at the read level (<linked_snps> XML field).

discover_roi_min_perc.description: Minimum co-occurrence proportion (0–1) to report a linked SNP.

discover_roi_min_reads.description: Minimum co-occurring read count to report a linked SNP.

discover_roi_min_snp_perc.description: Minimum variant frequency (0–1) for a SNP to be considered (as an anchor or linked candidate) in discover-roi linkage analysis. Skips low-frequency 'position of interest' SNPs to reduce search space.

out_file.description: Name of the output HTML file.

asaptools_options.title: Specific Options for ASAP Tools Processing

asaptools_processing.description: Enable/Disable the ASAP Tools R-script downstream processing.

asaptools_cov_table.description: Enable/Disable the ASAP Tools Coverage Table.

asaptools_qc_plots.description: Enable/Disable the ASAP Tools QC Plots (coverage, alignment, read funnel, breadth).

asaptools_snp_plots.description: Enable/Disable the ASAP Tools SNP Plots (positional prevalence, density, strand bias, base quality, genome track).

asaptools_snp_table.description: Enable/Disable the ASAP Tools SNP Table.

asaptools_snp_table_xls.description: Enable/Disable the ASAP Tools SNP Table XLS file. Generation is slow for larger sets do to colors and formating.

asaptools_interactive_plots.description: Also export the self-contained interactive HTML widgets for the QC and SNP figures. JPGs are always produced; the HTML widgets are expensive to render, so they are off by default.

asaptools_generate_fasta.description: Enable/Disable the ASAP Tools fasta generation.

asaptools_positions_of_interest.description: Path to CSV file containing genes/positions of interest. This is helpful if processing amplicon data using WGS reference.

asaptools_snp_proportion.description: SNP Table Parameter: Minimum proportion required to call a variant in the ASAP Tools script. If unset, falls back to `--proportion`.

asaptools_genbank_location.description: SNP Table Parameter: Path to the reference GenBank file.

asaptools_max_sample_snp_count.description: SNP Table Parameter: Maximum number of SNPs allowed per sample. This filters samples with >x snps in the SNP table.

asaptools_samples_to_remove.description: SNP Table Parameter: Comma-separated list of Sample IDs to exclude from the SNP table.

asaptools_breadth_threshold.description: Minimum breadth of coverage (>) to export FASTA files for. If unset, falls back to `--breadth`.

ivar.description: Execute full iVar workflow (trim, variants, consensus). Warning: incompatible with --smor.

ivar_trim.description: Flag to execute ivar trim ONLY. Not recommended.

ivar_variants.description: Flag to execute ivar variants ONLY. Useful for comparing ASAP SNPs to iVar.

ivar_consensus.description: Flag to execute ivar consensus ONLY.

bwa_container.description: Container image for bwa and samtools.

bowtie2_container.description: Container image for bowtie2 and samtools.

env_dir.description: Parent directory for shared conda/singularity environment caches (envs stored under <env_dir>/conda and <env_dir>/singularity), reused across runs and users instead of being rebuilt per work directory. Unset = Nextflow's default per-work-directory caching.
